title: 第23章 追踪与岩洞第24章 意外发现
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 帕维尔前去通知科奥队长。
罗德不打没有把握的仗。
哪怕是尾随抓捕也要带上足够的人手。
诺里斯进的洞肯定有问题。
西边和北边都不乏各种岩洞，其内四通八达。
有些通往高岭群山，有些甚至能通往海边。
罗德知道他不会老老实实的从陆路离开。
前后约莫一刻钟，帕维尔带来了三把钢臂军弩。
身后跟着科奥队长和另外三个护卫小伙子。
罗德简单的将情况说明了一下。
科奥队长顿时眯起了眼。
领地人口异常报损必有猫腻。
大概率是诺里斯私自将一部分青壮农奴给贩出了领地。
这是重罪，足以让他上绞刑架！
奥伦提亚联合王国虽然不禁止外来的奴隶商人。
但内部各大领主都是禁止贩奴的。
不同领地之间的农奴严禁往来。
流民主要是那些游离失所的自由民，还有部分“野人”。
王国有不少环境恶劣或是资源匮乏的荒郊野岭。
其内生活的自由民就被蔑称为野人。
农奴的人身依附于领主、被束缚在土地上。
无法拥有土地的所有权，也不享受王国法律的保护。
领主治下的司法便是他们的天。
此外还要承担沉重的劳动义务，属于半自由群体。
而自由民拥有人身自由和独立的法律地位。
还可自主支配劳动与财产。
农奴人口的获取途径主要靠自由民转化、战俘和繁衍后代。
有些走投无路的自由民会以自由换取庇护或生存机会。
除此之外，受国王批准的领地交易中也包含着农奴的转移。
在这个大框架下，私贩农奴是死罪。
罗德接过军弩，钢制的弩臂格外强韧。
易损的弩牙上烙有符文，使其更加坚固。
这是一把通过折叠杠杆上弦的中重型弩。
它既要比绞盘式重弩上弦更快，又比踏张弩的拉力更强。
很适合淬魔修行有所小成的军士使用。
卡林城中还有一款采用复合弩臂加双杠杆结构的plus版本。
拉力可达300至350磅。
是兼顾威力与机动性的军用弩。
在卡林邦城里，这些军弩都属于管制品。

;;
Pavel went to inform Captain Keo.
Rhodes does not fight uncertain battles.
Even if you are following and arresting, you must bring enough manpower.
There must be something wrong with the hole Norris got into.
There are various caves in the west and north, extending in all directions.
Some lead to high mountains, and some even lead to the sea.
Rhodes knew that he would not leave by land honestly.
About a quarter of an hour later, Pavel brought three steel-armed crossbows.
Behind him were Captain Keao and three other young escorts.
Rhodes briefly explained the situation.
Captain Keao suddenly narrowed his eyes.
There must be something fishy about reporting abnormal population losses in the territory.
There is a high probability that Norris secretly sold some young serfs out of the territory.
This is a serious crime, worthy of the gallows!
Although the United Kingdom of Orentia does not ban external slave traders.
However, all major internal lords prohibited slave trading.
It was strictly prohibited for serfs to travel between different territories.
The refugees are mainly free people who have lost their homes, and some "savages".
The kingdom has many wilderness areas with harsh environments or scarce resources.
The free people living in it were scornfully called savages.
The serf's body was attached to the lord and bound to the land.
There is no title to the land and no protection under the laws of the kingdom.
The justice under the lord is their heaven.
In addition, they have to bear heavy labor obligations and belong to a semi-free group.
Freemen had personal freedom and independent legal status.
They can also control their labor and property independently.
The serf population was mainly obtained through conversion of freedmen, prisoners of war and reproduction of offspring.
Some desperate freedmen would trade their freedom for shelter or a chance to survive.
In addition, territorial transactions approved by the king also included the transfer of serfs.
Within this general framework, smuggling serfs was a capital crime.
Rhodes took over the crossbow. The steel crossbow arm was particularly strong.
The fragile crossbow teeth are branded with runes to make them stronger.
This is a medium-heavy crossbow that is cocked via a folding lever.
It is not only faster to cock than the winch-type heavy crossbow, but also has a stronger pulling force than the step crossbow.
It is very suitable for soldiers who have achieved some success in quenching demons.
There is also a plus version in Carlin City that uses a composite crossbow arm and a double lever structure.
Pulling force can reach 300 to 350 pounds.
It is a military crossbow that combines power and maneuverability.
In the city of Kalimbang, these crossbows are controlled items.
